rules.statement: The production of the record and the evidence of the interpreter are sufficient to establish a conviction for intentionally giving false evidence in a judicial proceeding under Ceylon Evidence Ordinance, ss. 80 and 114.
rules.supporting_quote: "These facts being stated on the record will be presumed. Nor was it necessary for the interpreter to prove that there was a judicial proceeding, and that the oath or affirmation was duly administered, or that the Commissioners took down what the witnesses actually said, for these facts being stated on the record will be presumed."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Sections 80 and 114 of "The Ceylon Evidence Ordinance, 1896"
